'''2000 Phoenix Mega Weekend warmup tournament (3 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at AZ Gamer, Arizona on 3 November 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Jason Ayre's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1434">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-td1434/ pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-t], DeckTech (Your "thezrhino" Mom, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-td1434/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Mega Weekend]].

* '''Date:''' 3 November 2000
* '''Site:''' AZ Gamer, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
